quests.title: End of a Leisurely Holiday

dialogue.t: ...That should be enough to prove this isn't some sort of secret weapon.
Hmm... Sure does. Now you just need to make it a little tougher, and it might pose a challenge to adults as well.
Whoa! The atmosphere's getting all tense again, you don't think they're going to...
You're not far wrong... Hey, {NICKNAME}, since you're here, why not help us referee a fair fight?
*sigh* I don't know where this obsession with sparring has come from. Is it because I beat you so easily the last time? If that's what this is about, then let's just get it over with.
{NICKNAME}, keep your eyes peeled and see who blinks first!
Hmph! All those empty words aren't going to save you!
Whoa! Aren't they only supposed to be sparring!?
It's not too late to admit defeat! I'll give you three seconds...
Three, two, one...
Whoa!

dialogue.sit: There is a loud, metallic clack followed by calm silence...

dialogue.t: It's alright, Paimon, you can open your eyes.
It turns out the most "tense" person here was you...
Wh—What? Wislawa, you're not hurt!?

dialogue.sit: Edler only fired a warning shot.
There were no bullets in the musket.

dialogue.t: Of course. I don't want to end up stuck in some foreign prison...
I had to put on a show. Let her know I'm not some cowardly merchant she can just push around.
This way, the next time we meet, she'll think twice before causing me trouble.
But, {NICKNAME}, how did you know what was going on? You're not tense at all!

dialogue.sit: Edler said it herself — "see who blinks first."

dialogue.t: You're sharp. A well-placed threat's the fastest way to make someone surrender. It's just a shame that shortcuts are seldom so easy to take.
Not to mention, {NICKNAME} is here... Anyway, I'm still standing.
I just hope the next time we meet, I get a chance to...
Don't start with all that again. How many chances do you think we'll have to meet?
If the next time I see you, you happen to be on duty, I'll be forced to respond appropriately to any actions you take.
But if you're on holiday again, let's play another wargame or two — for the sake of my business.

quests.description: After days of intense “sparing,” the moment of parting quietly arrives…
